items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: he plays in my Manhattan band, the Gotham Jazz Men. And we play every Thursday... Lee Lorenz plays cornet.

ctx.x: That he played with them I think.

Well I specifically talked about Dick Voight, who is the piano player, who helped me take the survey so I could make the claim that we are the longest playing band, and the cornet player was Lee Lorenz, who is the cartoonist for the New Yorker, a multi-talented man, he’s also a writer, and he plays in my Manhattan band, the Gotham Jazz Men. And we play every Thursday, a noontime concert free, and thirty plus years. We are in our thirty-first year donating that jazz. And I heard Phil say, in response to your…
around the country playing in their local bands, then they convene at Hamilton and then we really have fun.
